title: Pinetucket Combo Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Renovated to studs, Seaside home steps from Seaside Avenue, the pools, family park, and only a 5-minute walk to the beach! Three king bedrooms, chef's kitchen, with designer furnishings and touches throughout.
description_expanded: Description486 FOREST STREET3 Kings, 1 Bunk Bed (twin over double)- Sleeps 9Discover the perfect Seaside, Florida vacation retreat with this beautifully renovated coastal home and private guest cottage—an ideal choice for families, couples traveling together, or groups seeking extra space and comfort. Located on Forest Street in the heart of Seaside, this property offers one of the best locations in town, just a 5-minute walk to the beach, steps from the Seaside pools, fitness center, and tennis courts, and a short stroll to Seaside’s Town Center for dining, shopping, and entertainment.Beautifully Updated Main HomeA welcoming foyer leads into the main residence, framed by two charming porches with flower-filled boxes. Inside, the thoughtful floorplan creates an easy flow between living, dining, and kitchen spaces. The home features two first-floor king bedrooms, making it an excellent layout for multi-generational travel.The private primary king suite includes patio access, a smart TV, fireplace, and a spa-inspired bathroom with dual vanities and a large glass-enclosed walk-in shower. The second king bedroom on the west side of the home offers custom built-ins, a window bench, a smart TV, and access to a renovated hall bathroom with a soaking tub and walk-in shower. A spiral staircase leads to a fun loft bunk room with a twin-over-full bunk, TV, storage, and its own A/C unit—perfect for kids or teens.Chef’s Kitchen & Relaxed Gathering SpacesThe fully updated kitchen is designed for cooking and entertaining, equipped with luxury appliances including a Wolf range and Sub-Zero refrigerator, plus a wet bar with Sub-Zero wine cooler. The dining table seats six, with additional island seating for three. After mealtime, unwind on the oversized porch bed swing, a guest favorite for morning coffee or evening relaxation.The living room on the east side of the home offers a bright, airy atmosphere with vaulted ceilings and a decorative fireplace (display only), creating a comfortable space to gather after a day at the beach.Private Guest Cottage for Extra SpaceThe detached guest cottage adds tremendous flexibility to this rental, making it ideal for families traveling with grandparents, another couple, or guests who appreciate privacy. Exterior stairs lead to the second floor entrance, where you’ll find a bistro dining nook, a kitchenette with fridge, microwave, and coffee maker, and a full bathroom with walk-in shower. The third-floor king bedroom features a mounted TV and cozy closet, creating a peaceful hideaway.Convenient Amenities & Ideal LocationGuests enjoy two washer/dryer sets, a spacious laundry room, and beach gear for children. A rear gate opens directly to a sandy footpath connecting to the tennis courts, playground, and pools. The beach is just 352 yards away, making it incredibly easy to enjoy Seaside’s sugar-white sand and turquoise water without needing a car.With its unbeatable location, thoughtful upgrades, and flexible layout, this home and guest cottage offer everything you need for a memorable Seaside vacation—whether you’re planning a family beach trip, a couples’ getaway, or an extended stay along Florida’s Scenic Highway 30A.* 5NT minimum stay Summer, Spring, & Spring Break; 3NT minimum in Fall; and 2NT minimum in Winter. You must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration. Features:2,294 square feet Just 352 yards (2-minute walk) to East Ruskin Pavilion, Seaside’s largest private residential beach on 30ATV in every bedroom for your convenienceTwo laundry rooms—one in the main home and one in the guest cottageFresh Peacock Alley towels and sheets throughout the homeAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome package includes 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 bikes for guest use (pickup at Seaside Transit Authority)Starter amenities provided, with attentive service throughout your stay2 parking passes included; golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibitedNo pets
